basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student living in Stuttgart, Germany, currently studying computer science. I have a strong interest in reptiles, especially chameleons, which I keep as pets. When I'm not studying, I enjoy listening to psychedelic rock bands like King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. I'm single and usually online during evenings and weekends. I work part-time at a local tech store, which helps me stay updated on the latest gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing understanding of computer science from my university courses. I'm also self-taught in reptile care through forums and YouTube channels. My interest in music comes from years of exploring different genres and attending local concerts.
